Using the Initial Compendium

This release is an initial playtest module for Foundry VTT V14 and the D&D5e system’s 2024 rules framework.

  • Etesia Actors: graduated SSP soldiers, archers, sergeants, clergy, mages, constructs, Harald, Vicar Kolokai Sanguis, and Lady Amara Grethry.
  • Etesia Items: campaign-authored items plus provisional Shatter Grenade, launcher, and Soul Stone records.
  • Etesia Journals: canon, factions, source transcriptions, and player handouts.
  • World Transfer packs: intentionally empty working packs for copying world documents between the Etesia and Arniea campaigns. Unlock a transfer pack, drag world documents into it, then enable the module in the destination world and import them.

The actor mechanics that were not specified in the source documents are original provisional playtest designs. Their lore and encounter roles follow the campaign instructions, but their numbers should be adjusted after table use.
